summary: Genvor Inc filed an 8-K regarding a securities purchase agreement with Evergreen Capital Management for a convertible note (up to $800,000 principal) and warrants (up to 600,000 shares) at an aggregate purchase price of up to $666,668, paid in four tranches. The note carries 10% interest, is convertible at $1.00 per share (or 80% of lowest VWAP during 5 days before conversion upon default), with a 9-month maturity or upon exchange listing. The warrants have a 5-year term, cashless exercise, and initial exercise price of $1.00. This is a standard financing agreement, not a special situation, as it involves routine capital raising without triggering acquisition, restructuring, or other special categories.
